objective: Test Astra native direct weight writing and mechanism-sensitive repair using MIT-like semantic contracts, no fitting/gradients by editor, and genuinely new fictional user/item identities; separately test real cold-start transfer without claiming real pretraining membership exclusion.

source_audit.analogy: Exp5 single-reply no-tool weight writing, Exp4 weights+behavior-trace repair, Exp6/8 externally budgeted forward feedback. Not anonymous MF accuracy optimization. MIT negative Gemma result and weaker zero-forward Go result must remain visible.
source_audit.difference_from_v7: No regression, least squares, fitting, data-derived optimization or automatic search by editor. No6operation or0.5relativeL2 restriction: from-zero writing needs full freedom. Native tool-free CLI where supported; audit actual event streams, disclose any fallback.

pretraining_scope.strong_control: Generate fictional UUID users/items, random attribute compositions and preferences only after this protocol exists. All identities are new synthetic experimental entities, not films/persons from a corpus. Final entities never exposed to Astra. General concepts/arithmetic/rules may be familiar from pretraining; the experiment tests applying them to new entities.
pretraining_scope.information_limit: An unseen anonymous ID with no preferences, metadata or support observations contains no evidence of private user taste. Do not infer absence of pretraining membership merely from ID relabeling; do not interpret cold-start success with explicit profiles as discovering unknown preferences.

baselines.symbolic_compiler: Exact fixed policy-to-same-MLP compiler plus direct independent utility oracle; verify equality on random/exhaustiveboolean inputs. A strong conventional baseline, not Astra. Success cannot be called a new recommendation algorithm merely because it compiles rules.
baselines.bp: Same22-32-32-1 architecture; MSE on utility/40; export W3/b3x40 for raw outputunits. Adam lr.003 wd1e-6 batch1024 max400epochs patience40 warmvalidMSE only; train sizes128,2048,16384 × tasks0,1,2 × seeds42,43,44 =27trials. Max3500seconds pertrial.
baselines.cold_aware_bp: Task1 high-data three seeds, same original labels and same update budget as corresponding BP, independently dropout both known flags during training. Stronger conventional robustness control,3extra trials.
baselines.fixed_fold_repair: Fold two constant warm-status input columns into firstlayerbias and zero their weights. No fitting or labels; preserves warm function. This is evaluator-only classical control, never supplied as a repair suggestion to Astra.
baselines.random_zero: Zero/random initialized networks, same inference interface; metadata withheld/shuffled ablations are information controls, not fully featured competitive recommenders.

native_writing.inputs: Only architecture, exactchannel semantics and natural-language policy rules; nonce condition renames features/concepts with fresh symbols and gives complete mapping. No source/train/practice/validation/test entities, arrays, outcomes or examples.
native_writing.budget: One reply, zero forward passes and no tools. Return sparse numeric weight-edit DSL and concise functional explanation. No fitting/search/gradient. Effortxhigh.
native_writing.application: Evaluator parses literal tensor assignments/slices/arithmetic, not arbitrary executable Python; no imports/calls/loops or model callbacks. Finitefloat32absolutevalue<=1e6. Invalid reply countedfailure, no content-changing retries.
native_writing.negative_controls: Apply frozen networks with user preferences removed, item attributes removed, both removed/ID-only inputs, and fieldshuffling without contractupdate. These are paired test-time information ablations, not new editor conditions or competing optimizers.

native_repair.sources: Predeclared warm-only highdata BPcheckpoints seeds42,43,44, not selected by cold failure severity. Features20/21constant1inwarmtraining; unseenentityinferencechangesstatus. This is a designed nuisance-invariance stresssetting, not a claim about naturally prevalent production faults.
native_repair.inputs: Existing weights, architecture/semantic contract and same task rules, one fixed64-pair diagnosticpracticebatch with modeloutputs and policytargets. No fixedfold recipe, corruption label, finalentityor testlabels supplied.

One candidate per reply, finalcandidate is lastreply, no test-based selection. Baseline traces are already behavior information, never label as zero-feedback repair.
native_repair.updates: Cumulative direct weight edits; preserve warm behavior as faraspossible, record numerical locality and changed parameter count. No norm/sparsitycap imposed; distinguish targeted repair from full rewrite.
native_repair.turns: 6one-shot repairs plus6three-turn repairs =24turns;12writingturns =>36researchmodelrequests. Ephemeral freshCLI calls with visible transcript/currentweights reconstruction ifpersistedresumeunavailable; disclose difference.
